policy.purpose: Keep product eligibility, fulfillment, output scope, revisions and rights distinct between Audio+ short orders and professional studio project routes.

audience.observed_statement: Покупатель — физическое лицо (данный сервис не предназначен для юридических лиц и ИП).

observed_scope: Choose from the product page's audio-purpose options.
One order produces one file / one finished thought.
Product page displays a text limit of 90 words.
The offer text describes prepayment and a telephone greeting delivered in one version without alternate takes.

offer_text_observations: Offer clause 3.4 says the text cannot be changed after payment.
Offer clause 3.5 says the service does not rework or remake previously recorded audio materials.
Offer clause 3.8.1 restricts changes after acceptance into production.
Offer clause 3.11 describes a motivated objection within two business days and correction of deficiencies in a reasonable time.
revisions.product_page_observation: The indexed product UI shows an optional paid change/correction/add-sounds entry (790 RUB observed), but the relation to offer clauses 3.4, 3.5, 3.8.1 and 3.11 is unresolved; not a current price or unconditional editing promise.
revisions.instruction: Do not promise editing, correction, re-recording or quote a current fee until the current offer and the meaning/stage of the product-page option are clarified.

rights.instruction: Do not transfer this wording to professional service routes or reinterpret it as an exclusive-right transfer.

self-service options, one-file/one-thought limit, 90-word input limit and product-page edit option
25-Nov indexed observation of one-order/one-file/one-thought, 90-word field, service options, price banner and edit option; not live verified

fresh_indexed_observations_2026_11_25.freshness_note: Search-index publication/refresh metadata and extracted crawl-age metadata disagree; this is a source observation, not a live page state.

dynamic_counter_observations.interpretation: different dynamic surface counters; not unique customers, paid orders, revenue or conversion

offer_page.clause_1_1: Buyer defined as a natural person; offer text says service is not intended for legal entities and individual entrepreneurs.
offer_page.clause_3_4: Text cannot be changed after payment, as worded in the observed offer.
offer_page.clause_3_5: Service does not rework/remake already recorded audio materials, as worded in the observed offer.
offer_page.clause_3_8_1: Observed clause restricts changes after acceptance into production.
offer_page.clause_3_11: Motivated objections are described within two business days; deficiencies are to be corrected within a reasonable time, as worded in the observed offer.
offer_page.clause_16_1: Observed text retains exclusive right at service and gives the buyer a simple non-exclusive licence with sublicensing as worded.

unresolved_conflicts: The page displays a paid edit/correction/add-sounds option while offer clauses 3.4, 3.5 and 3.8.1 restrict changes/rework at different stages; the relationship and applicability are not reconciled.

The UI includes video voice-over while the offer definitions enumerate telephone greeting, informational audio commercial and congratulatory audio; contract coverage of video voice-over is not established.
Displayed prices/fees and page metadata are not live-verified current terms.
inference_rules: Do not use indexed prices as current offers or publish them as a live price list.
Do not promise editing, correction or re-recording based on the UI option alone.
Do not treat video voice-over UI selection as proof that the dated offer covers it.
Do not generalize Audio+ audience, rights or revision terms to professional studio projects.
Do not treat page counters as verified unique buyers, paying customers, sales or conversion.

rights.observed_page_statement: transfer of author's and exclusive rights is listed among the service elements

non_equivalence_rules: A short-order Audio+ product is not a default destination or price basis for professional project routes.
Individual-buyer eligibility, a one-file workflow and short text limits must not be silently generalised to business project scopes.
A non-exclusive licence model must not be replaced by an exclusive-right transfer statement; the reverse transfer is also prohibited without source evidence.
A project page's list of service elements does not prove every item is included in every quote.
Do not infer PBX configuration, telephony routing or live system integration from a statement that audio files are prepared for upload.
The product-page edit option and offer restrictions on changes/rework remain an unresolved source conflict.
